title: Find by role
summary: A role describes what an element does. A button role and its name make a locator that resembles how a person finds the control.
introduction: A role describes what an element does. A button role and its name make a locator that resembles how a person finds the control. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A role describes what an element does. A button role and its name make a locator that resembles how a person finds the control.

blocks.title: Find by role

blocks.text: The locator finds the Borrow button.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add a Return button and locate it by name.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A button with no useful name is hard for both people and tests to find.
For more detail later, use this [Playwright further reading](https://playwright.dev/docs/intro).

seo.title: Playwright: Find by role
seo.description: Learn about find by role in Playwright. Follow a small example, understand the result, and practise with a clear question.
